arguments.sql:
WITH airports AS (
    SELECT airport_code,
           json_extract(city, '$.en') AS city_name,
           radians(CAST(substr(coordinates, 2, instr(coordinates, ',') - 2) AS REAL)) AS longitude,
           radians(CAST(rtrim(substr(coordinates, instr(coordinates, ',') + 1), ')') AS REAL)) AS latitude
    FROM main.airports_data
),
flight_haversines AS (
    SELECT min(departure.city_name, arrival.city_name) AS city1,
           max(departure.city_name, arrival.city_name) AS city2,
           power(sin((arrival.latitude - departure.latitude) / 2.0), 2)
           + cos(departure.latitude) * cos(arrival.latitude)
             * power(sin((arrival.longitude - departure.longitude) / 2.0), 2) AS haversine
    FROM main.flights AS f
    JOIN airports AS departure ON departure.airport_code = f.departure_airport
    JOIN airports AS arrival ON arrival.airport_code = f.arrival_airport
),
pair_distances AS (
    SELECT city1, city2,
           avg(2.0 * 6371.0 * asin(sqrt(min(1.0, haversine)))) AS average_km
    FROM flight_haversines
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distance_ranges(lower_km) AS (
    VALUES (0), (1000), (2000), (3000), (4000), (5000), (6000)
),
range_counts AS (
    SELECT r.lower_km, count(p.average_km) AS pair_count
    FROM distance_ranges AS r
    LEFT JOIN pair_distances AS p
      ON p.average_km >= r.lower_km
     AND (r.lower_km = 6000 OR p.average_km < r.lower_km + 1000)
    GROUP BY r.lower_km
)
SELECT lower_km, pair_count,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM main.flights) AS total_flights,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM flight_haversines) AS joined_flights,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pair_distances) AS distinct_pairs,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pair_distances WHERE city1 = city2) AS same_city_pairs
FROM range_counts
ORDER BY lower_km
